sloka: नाजानाज्जीवतीं रामः स मां लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः ।जानन्तौ तौ न कुर्यातां नोर्व्यां हि मम मार्गणम् ।। ५.२४.३७।।।।
transliteration: nājānājjīvatīṁ rāmaḥ sa māṁ lakṣmaṇapūrvajaḥ ।jānantau tau na kuryātāṁ norvyāṁ hi mama mārgaṇam ।। 5.24.37।।।।

translations.english: 'O beautiful Sita seven thousand ogresses will be at your beck and call. (Therefore) accept Ravana, the lord of all ogres as your husband.
